description: HOMER Pro Simulation Results and Configurations for a Hybrid Renewable Energy System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Amira Ayada (Université Larbi Tébessi). This dataset contains the HOMER Pro simulation results and electrical load profile used for the analysis of a hybrid renewable energy system in Bir El Ater, Tebessa, Algeria. The dataset includes the considered system configurations and their corresponding technical and economic performance indicators, together with the load profile used in the simulations. Coverage: national (DZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
